decision_conditions: On the basis of the information submitted, and given the lack of essential information and evidence in connection with the proposed consultancy business' operations, this application would go beyond the scope of a lawful development certificate. As such, planning permission is required for the change of use of the garage within a single family dwellinghouse as a work space to provide accommodation for working from home in connection with paediatric consultancy business.
